title: Trapeziectomy and Suture Suspensionplasty for Thumb Carpometacarpal Arthritis - Is In-Clinic Therapy Needed?
official: Trapeziectomy and Suture Suspensionplasty for Thumb Carpometacarpal Arthritis - Is In-Clinic Therapy Needed?
summary: The study is a randomized, controlled trial to evaluate the efficacy of formal occupational therapy on outcomes following CMC arthroplasty
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over the age of 18 years
* Patients undergoing CMC Arthroplasty
* Ability to read and write in English
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing revision CMC arthroplasty
* Acute traumatic dislocation of the CMC joint as indication for surgery
* Concomitant treatment of MCP hyperextension
